_comment: Journey card deck for the full-feel demo (/demo). Each card is one visitor's
path through the product: a persona, and an ordered rail they walk.
Validated by scripts/check-demo-rails.ts, wired into CI as ci:demo-rails.
The validator refuses a card whose persona does not exist, whose atoms are
not on disk, or whose interactive blocks do not parse — so a card that would
dead-end in front of a visitor fails the build instead.
Coherence rule: an atom rail's concept must appear in the persona's
initial_mastery, unless the card sets first_exposure. A card claiming 'weak
in linear algebra' sitting on a profile with no linear-algebra mastery is
the fixture incoherence the CEO plan's D3.2 calls out, and it is easy to
introduce by accident when personas and cards are edited separately.
